verdict.rationale: Sardine documents that transaction data runs through its own no-code rule editor to detect anomalous behavior, and that its rule engine can build rules around business entities, so configurable transaction monitoring rules are covered. Segment-specific thresholds are not evidenced; the only threshold tuning described is for fuzzy screening matches, which is a different feature. Missing for 10: documented segment- or cohort-specific thresholds for transaction monitoring, detail on rule-configuration depth (conditions, testing, versioning), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds

citations.quote: run them through our proprietary no-code rule editor to pick up anomalous behavior
Rules can be created around business entities through the rule engine.
